baseline.convention: LRC(m) denotes m positive integer moving speeds and m+1 total runners, including the stationary runner
baseline.lowerStatement: For each m in {1,...,12}, for every u in Z_{>0}^m, there exists t in R such that for every i in {1,...,m}, norm(t*u_i) >= 1/(m+1).

targets.statement: For every u in Z_{>0}^{13}, there exists t in R such that for every i in {1,...,13}, norm(t*u_i) >= 1/14.
For every u in Z_{>0}^{14}, there exists t in R such that for every i in {1,...,14}, norm(t*u_i) >= 1/15.

baseline.sourceAdoption: Only exact premise or implication statements with immutable source/statement/scope pins may be explicitly adopted. Adoption retains source debt and never establishes independent reproduction. Adopting the target theorem itself is not mathematical advance or independent reproduction.
baseline.discovery: A separately bound candidate states source differences, potential gain, falsification predicate, strongest objection, targeted obligation and novelty pending. No discovery success is predeclared.

master.edgeOrientation: prerequisite -> dependent; multi-premise implications retain the complete ordered antecedent list
edgeTemplates: Copy the frozen 23-aggregate dependency lists as SOURCE_REPORTED_DEPENDENCIES only, not evidence.
For every target-specific prime: GENERATION -> LIFT; LIFT plus matching PRIME_DIVISIBILITY_CRITERION -> TERMINAL.
Each per-prime stage -> its corresponding exact target aggregate, with the full prime-set denominator retained.
ROOT_LRC_13_MOVING_14_TOTAL -> ESTABLISHED_LRC_13, which remains a prerequisite of the 15-total target.
Matching analytic bound, prime divisibility, all terminal coverage, and forced-divisor evidence where needed -> GLOBAL_LOG_CLOSURE_n.
Matching primitive/distinct reduction, analytic reduction, all terminal stages, divisibility criterion and GLOBAL_LOG_CLOSURE_n -> ROOT_LRC_n_MOVING_(n+1)_TOTAL.
master.terminalMethod: SOURCE_MATCH_REQUIRED_PER_PRIME; CRT/shift/common-level is not assigned to every prime by name
master.shiftNode: A reusable conditional statement; cannot by itself discharge any prime terminal or global root
master.initialStates: OPEN; historical admissible references may project separate finite/source dimensions but cannot silently discharge global obligations

implicationAdmission.hostTrust: Host registry resolves an actually admitted artifact; a model may propose references but cannot author admission or PROVED.
implicationAdmission.conditionalRootRule: Every critical node and complete implication edge is admitted under the same explicit assumption closure. Missing, false, mismatched, circular or incoherently scoped edges refuse closure even when all nodes say closed.
implicationAdmission.finiteRule: Finite domain coverage never proves a universal real-time implication without separately admitted symbolic alignment.
implicationAdmission.independentRule: No outstanding source-adopted premise/edge and actual statement-aligned independent evidence for every required obligation; NOT_ESTABLISHED in this initial release.

shiftUnit.statement: Assume LRC(m) for every m in {1,...,12}. For every u in Z_{>0}^{14} and every prime d, let E={i in {1,...,14}: d does not divide u_i}, e=|E| and m_d=ceil(2d/15). If e>=2 and e*m_d<d, then there exists t in R such that for every i in {1,...,14}, norm(t*u_i)>=1/15.
shiftUnit.repeatedAndNonprimitiveSpeeds: Allowed by this statement; any distinct/primitive restriction for the larger source proof remains a separate reduction obligation
analyticalDebt: Existence and domain alignment of the lower continuous witness
Real-time phase partition argument and its independently admitted statement alignment

finiteDomain.phases: Canonical reduced rational offsets in [0,1); supplied tuple has exactly e entries

shiftUnit.capMeaning: Explicit charged arithmetic/comparison/partition work model plus cooperative monotonic deadline; not hard OS preemption. Parse bytes and component lengths before BigInt work; refuse any intermediate component beyond 256 bits.
shiftUnit.unsupported: Well-formed d/e/domain outside the four sealed classes returns UNSUPPORTED without mathematical verdict; malformed data is REFUSED. No silent domain widening.

fields.offsets: ordered canonical rationals in [0,1), exactly e

fields.partitions: one exact partition for each a in 1..d-1, ordered by a
fields.tupleBadMasks: one recomputed sorted mask for each supplied offset/residue, exactly e
fields.goodShiftIndices: exact sorted complement of tuple mask union in 0..d-1

fields.cells: for each boundary, a singleton BOUNDARY then adjacent OPEN cell; last open cell wraps to first boundary+1

fields.right: left for singleton; next unwrapped boundary for OPEN
fields.representative: boundary or exact midpoint reduced mod1 for OPEN
fields.badShiftIndices: exact sorted unique j satisfying strict bad predicate

finiteSchemas.independentConsumer: Consumer derives all required boundaries, adjacency, wrap, masks, maxima, unit coverage and tuple good shifts independently from input; it does not call producer or accept coherent hash-only content.
finiteSchemas.continuityDebt: Masks are constant between all predicate zeros by a written symbolic argument; representative arithmetic alone is not universal real-time proof.
finiteSchemas.schemaSemanticRequirements: Schema is shape-only. Host additionally checks exactly e tuple entries, certificate/input d match, a<d, j<d sorted masks, canonical reduced fractions/component bits, complete partitions and exact content against independently derived finite semantics.
finiteSchemas.speedToPhaseBinding: An optional benchmark speed/t witness is separately bound and checked; phase certificate does not assert that arbitrary offsets arise from a common lower witness.

methodCards.applicability: SATISFIED/OPEN/REFUTED per exact premise evidence; source adoption remains a separate dimension; conditional policy may retain OPEN debts; unavailable tool DEFERRED; wrong convention/refuted premise REFUSED
methodCards.heuristics: Explained root contribution, discrimination, readiness, cost/uncertainty and distinct predicates; not truth probability

proposedApis.preparedCapIncludes: Exact UTF8 stdin plus schema plus canonical retained metadata; no duplicated full solver host envelope in reviewer stdin
proposedApis.findingCoverage: All 6 premise IDs and 7 step IDs exactly once for each role; CONDITIONAL/OPEN/MISSING/DISPUTED only; no PROVED
proposedApis.separateSummary: REVIEWED_CONDITIONAL, INCONCLUSIVE or REJECTED, plus finite checker result and unresolved debts; never global root PROVED
proposedApis.durableExternalIdentity: All v4/ledger7 persistent guards require actual trusted caseId/runId/contractDigest and host-resolved unit/source/checker references
proposedApis.transientVsPersistent: Transient model output can carry feedback only. Worker attaches host evidence after trusted adapter output; persistent v4 requires exact paired evidence and feedback. Legacy adapters do not accept or emit new fields.
proposedApis.usageAndContexts: Actual transport usage and distinct context IDs retained; same model contexts are operationally separate, not independent mathematics
proposedApis.legacy: Contracts1/2/3, ledger1..6 and absent optional fields retain byte-identical canonical encodings; never backfill or reinterpret v3/ledger6
proposedApis.cycles: Old ES/LRC-proofunit exclusions remain; prospective method lane uses explicit authorized jobs and its own bounded policy, not guard removal
proposedApis.criticInput: Bound full solverAttemptDigest plus host finiteEvidenceDigest and compact typed summary. No adversary prose is supplied to critic; adversary digest remains host ledger lineage. Missing seed yields explicit MISSING finite record supplied to critic, never a manufactured check.
proposedApis.roleInputSignatures: prepareLrcMethodUnitSolverInput({contractDigest,caseId,runId,requestedModelName}); prepareLrcMethodUnitReviewInput({role,contractDigest,caseId,runId,requestedModelName,solverAttempt,solverAttemptDigest,finiteEvidence?}). ADVERSARY forbids finiteEvidence; CRITIC requires a validated finiteEvidence record (including honest MISSING/UNSUPPORTED/refusal).
proposedApis.finiteEvidencePlacement: ledger7 host-only; solver attempt remains immutable, not retroactively patched after finite check
proposedApis.finiteEvidenceRenderer: A compact <=1024B summary plus report digest is part of exact critic stdin. Full finite input/certificate is host-retained in ledger evidence, not duplicated into critic stdin.
proposedApis.finiteEvidenceTrust: Only review job host creates evidence after actual bounded producer and independently derived consumer return. Provider output schemas exclude evidence, checker/producer hashes, counters, dispatch IDs and receipts. Source hashes resolve the frozen host registry; recomputed content hashes are identity, not malicious-host cryptographic authenticity.

finiteEvidence.seedSemanticRequirements: Exactly e entries; d3 requires e2/a<=2; d5 requires e2..4/a<=4; canonical reduced rationals/256bits; no certificate supplied by model
finiteEvidence.optionalSeed: New solver model-authored payload may supply lrcMethodUnitFiniteSeed:null or a strict small seed. Its bytes count inside the aggregate16KiB solver math payload. No model checker receipt is accepted.
finiteEvidence.execution: After trusted adversary return, host validates retained solver seed; creates full input/certificate; calls independent bounded consumer; retains actual result before critic preparation. Producer+consumer together share5s/2M charged operation budget; no subprocess/provider/forest.
finiteEvidence.result: Exact finite tupleBadMasks/goodShiftIndices, maximumBadPerException, m_d and coverage counts; no real-time/lower/global/proof flag except NOT_ESTABLISHED
finiteEvidence.noRun: For missing/null seed: MISSING; seedDigest/input/inputDigest/certificateDigest/producer/checker/result are null, no fabricated zero elapsed/counters. Out-of-scope refusal never claims completed finite coverage. Any non-CHECKED_FINITE status prevents the aggregate method-unit audit from gaining REVIEWED_CONDITIONAL; MISSING remains INCONCLUSIVE even with unanimous conditional model findings.
finiteEvidence.recordDigest: sha256(canonicalJson(record without recordDigest)); inputDigest covers exact complete finite input; outputDigest covers actual canonical consumer result
finiteEvidence.passiveValidation: Checks strict shape/status consistency, external record IDs/job lineage, registered source/version pins and all retained byte/content digests without executing producer/checker on GET. Host checker execution authenticity is local unsigned provenance, not external attestation.
finiteEvidence.criticRequiredBinding: CRITIC prepared metadata and exact stdin contain finiteEvidenceDigest matching the retained ledger record; summary is recomputed from that record, not model supplied
finiteEvidence.ledger7RequiredBinding: Full immutable attempt, both actual role reports/prepared inputs and finite evidence share exact case/run/contract/unit/predicate/obligation/source IDs; finite report lineage matches the same review job and preceding adversary digest

benchmarkPredicates.falseCandidateStatement: For d=3,e=2, every admissible rational offset/unit tuple has at least d-e*ceil(2d/15)+1 good shift indices.

falseCandidateControl.expectedDesignOnly: Bad masks {0} and {2}; good set {1}; no checker executed in pre-seal phase

benchmarkPredicates.discoveryExecution: NOT_DISPATCHABLE unless exact candidate/domain is admitted; the approved d/e checker may not widen to cases outside strict sufficient bound
benchmarkPredicates.incompleteCertificate: Same known predicate with a required boundary/open cell or unit partition removed; refusal is certificate failure, not LRC refutation

remainingSealDecisions: Contractor accepts deterministic graph templates, quotas and no per-prime terminal-method inference
Contractor accepts exact finite schema, conservative intermediate 256-bit refusal and charged operation model
Contractor accepts additive v4/ledger7 API names and strict trusted artifact admission boundary
Checker implementation hash and renderer-v1 registry are frozen after product implementation before any G2
